title: See My Books!
description: Adds visual representation of books in chiseled bookshelves.
body:
This mod adds new textures for different book types in chiseled bookshelves allowing for more decoration options when building with chiseled bookshelves and to see what each type of book is.

![All the books](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62d2a48992d826c2d6c726d1c01096f66743f344.png)

---
### ⚠️Important⚠️


This mod fundamentally rewrites how the chiseled bookshelves blocks work and to avoid item deletion and things of that nature remove all the books in your bookshelves before adding it in your world.
